title: Tetsuryō! meet with Tetsudō Musume Anime's 2nd Promo Video Reveals Ending Theme Song, Additional Cast, October Premiere
content: Pony Canyon began streaming on Monday the second promotional video for Tetsuryō! meet with Tetsudō Musume , the original television anime based on the Tetsudō Musume (Railway Girls) characters, and it announces the October premiere.
author: ANN

title: Ryūki Ōnuma, Hikari Komaru's Doggo Manga Ends
content: Ryūki Ōnuma and Hikari Komaru 's DOGGO ( INNU ) manga ended with its 74th chapter on the YanMaga Web site on Saturday. The final chapter stated both authors are currently preparing a new work.
author: ANN

title: Tetsuryo Meet With Tetsudou Musume Anime Unveils New Visual, Trailer, October 2026 Premiere Date
content: The upcoming Tetsuryo Meet With Tetsudou Musume anime unveiled a new visual and trailer on Monday along with an October 2026 premiere date. Seventeen additional cast members were also revealed. EAST FISH STUDIO is animating the series.

title: BANANA FISH Coming to Netflix U.S. in August with Exclusive New English & French Dub
content: BANANA FISH will begin streaming on Netflix in the United States on August 12, bringing the anime series to the platform with exclusive new English and French dubs. Netflix also revealed the lead voice cast for both language tracks.
author: Anime Corner

title: Toilet-Bound Hanako-kun Manga Resumes on August 18
content: The manga entered a hiatus in the magazine's December 2025 issue on November 18, due to Aida's medical treatment for an unspecified illness. The series took a break in July 2025 and returned in August 2025.
author: ANN

title: Manga 'Noa-senpai wa Tomodachi' Receives TV Anime Adaptation
content: Production company Kadokawa opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Enma Akiyama 's Noa-senpai wa Tomodachi ( Noa Is My Senior, and My Friend ) manga on Monday, revealing the main staff and a teaser visual (pictured right).
author: MyAnimeList
